default_body.markdown: ## Updates:- GP#2065: Added Compress and Share Save feature to the saves management screen (by @MovTery)- GP#2062: Added support for independently configuring renderer plugin environment variables in version settings (by @youfeng11, @MovTery)- GP#2083: Added "Browse in Other File Managers" option to the file manager more menu (by @MovTery)## Refactors:- GP#2066: Pinned the main interface card toolbar to the bottom of the screen (by @MovTery)## Changes:- GP#2077: Dialogs displaying SDL-side messages now use the launcher theme (by @MovTery)## Fixes:- GP#2053: Percent-encode the file name in CurseForge download links (by @MovTery)- GP#2049: Validate the displacement direction input when dragging cards, rejecting invalid direction vectors (by @dryfish09)- GP#2064: Fixed skin preview in the wardrobe not displaying until capes finish loading (by @youfeng11)- GP#2068: Mod update check repeatedly prompting for the same version due to an expired baseline date (by @MovTery)- GP#2078: SDL side unable to properly open links or browse directories (by @MovTery)- GP#2079: Render state not restored after the in-game surface is rebuilt, causing misaligned rendering (by @MovTery)- GP#2080: Removed the NeoForge early loading screen, fixing the interface freeze issue (by @MovTery)- GP#2082: SDL_EGL_LIBRARY is now constructed following the plugin path convention and validated for existence (by @MovTery)- GP#2089: Fixed the internal dialog popped up by the input method being mistakenly closed by the launcher (by @MovTery)

bodies.markdown: ## 更新：- GP#2065：存档管理屏幕新增 “压缩存档并分享” (by @MovTery)- GP#2062：支持在版本设置中独立配置渲染器插件的环境变量 (by @youfeng11，@MovTery)- GP#2083：在文件管理器更多菜单中新增 “在其他管理器应用内浏览” (by @MovTery)## 重构：- GP#2066：使主界面卡片的工具栏固定屏幕底部 (by @MovTery)## 调整：- GP#2077：展示 SDL 端消息时，对话框使用启动器主题 (by @MovTery)## 修复：- GP#2053：CurseForge 下载链接应对文件名进行百分号编码 (by @MovTery)- GP#2049：校验卡片拖动的让位方向输入，拒绝非法方向向量 (by @dryfish09)- GP#2064：修复衣橱中的皮肤预览在加载完披风前不显示的问题 (by @youfeng11)- GP#2068：模组更新检查因基准日期过期导致同版本反复提示更新的问题 (by @MovTery)- GP#2078：SDL 端无法正常打开链接、浏览目录 (by @MovTery)- GP#2079：游戏运行中 surface 重建后渲染状态未恢复导致画面错位 (by @MovTery)- GP#2080：去掉 NeoForge 早期加载屏，解决界面冻死的问题 (by @MovTery)- GP#2082：SDL_EGL_LIBRARY 按插件路径约定拼接并校验存在性 (by @MovTery)- GP#2089：修复输入法弹出内部对话框后被启动器误关闭的问题 (by @MovTery)
